risk_if_not_implemented: Without Information In Shared Resources, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Information In Shared Resources (SEA-14) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Privilege
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Privilege (IAC-30) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Information In Shared Resources (SEA-14) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
